text:
ana: Quick heads-up 1 rv3b onboarding smoke in staging: overall NDCG@10 +0.9% but MRR@10 on multilingual short queries (jp/ko, tokens<=5) down -4.2%. Need a fast triage.

pranav: Can you paste the slice table? multilingual includes zh?

ana: Table from eval-batch-824: 
```
slice               ndcg10  mrr10  top1_rate
overall             +0.9%   -0.3%  -0.8pp
short_en (<=5)      +0.2%   -0.9%  -1.4pp
short_jp/ko (<=5)   -0.6%   -4.2%  -5.7pp
long_all (>5)       +1.5%   +0.8%  +0.5pp
```
Note: eval dataset = holdout_v4-multi (en,jp,ko,zh) with tokenization via new unify_tok v2.

toni: Did the model change tokenization or unicode normalizer? rv3b PR mentioned unicode_nfkc_strip. That can break CJK token boundaries.

ana: Yes we switched to unicode_nfkc_strip + merge_spaces and applied new candidate dedupe normalization. Also applied int8 PTQ with per-channel calibration.

pranav: My suspicion: NF KC plus strip may collapse width-variants or punctuation differences used by short queries to match exact tokens. For CJK short queries, exact char matches matter a lot.

eval-bot: Run 824 comparison: queued variants (A) rv3b + legacy_tok + fp16 (B) rv3b + unify_tok v2 + fp16 (C) rv3b + unify_tok v2 + int8. ETA ~18m.

toni: Also check candidate dedupe order: if strip merges candidates, top1 could flip to a different doc. That would reduce MRR/top1 but not necessarily NDCG.

ana: Running a fast ablation now. If legacy_tok recovers short_jp/ko MRR -> it's formatting. If int8 adds additional delta -> quantization interaction.

pranav: Add extra metrics: exact_char_match_rate, top1_confidence, duplicate_merge_count.

eval-bot: Job 824A finished: legacy_tok + fp16 -> short_jp/ko MRR delta = +3.9% vs baseline (i.e. recovered). top1_rate delta = +4.8pp.

ana: 824B (unify_tok v2 + fp16) = baseline numbers earlier (-4.2pp). 824C (unify_tok v2 + int8) = extra -0.9pp on short_jp/ko.

toni: So primary cause = tok normalization change. int8 worsens slightly. Good.

pranav: Actionable: revert unicode_nfkc_strip for queries in CJK locales or use locale-aware tokenizer. Rolling a short-term rule: if locale in {jp,ko,zh} and query_len<=5 use legacy tokenizer. Low-risk.

ana: Filed issue and rollout: https://go/rollout/rv3b-cjk-token-fix. Planning 5% A/B for 6h to validate.

infra-bot: Deploy plan created by ana: rollout/rv3b-cjk-token-fix (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with safety window 6h.

toni: Also follow-up: can the unify_tok v2 be updated to preserve width variants or provide an opt-out map for short CJK spans? We should improve tokenizer rather than keep hacks.

pranav: Agreed. I'll make a ticket to prototyping a preserve_width option and add unit tests with CJK short queries.

ana: Thanks. We'll hold on full Dedicated rollout until A/B completes. I'll post live metrics here once A/B runs.

eval-bot: A/B running. Collecting top1/mrr/exact_match every 10m.

ana: Appreciate the quick triage. Learned two lessons: formatting changes can create large short-query MRR regressions even while NDCG improves slightly; quantization can amplify but often smaller.

toni: Good catch. If A/B is clean we'll keep int8 but ship tokenization fix.

pranav: Adding a small eval harness around tokenizer changes in PR review checklist.
